WELCOME TO RAINFOREST MOTEL IN FOX GLACIER
The Rainforest Motel is a family-owned and operated motel situated in the small, picturesque village of Fox Glacier on the West Coast of the South Island. We are perfectly situated for you to enjoy a relaxing break while exploring the tranquillity of the Westland National Park and South West World Heritage Area.
We are within walking distance of a number of good-quality restaurants serving great food, wines and coffee, yet only a short drive will take you to the spectacular ice formations of the Fox Glacier, the tranquil beauty of Lake Matheson and the Peak Viewpoint, or the wild, rugged coastline at Gillespies Beach.
Rainforest Motel is a quiet Fox Glacier accommodation option for travellers who want ground-floor motel units, kitchen facilities, parking and easy access to village dining, glacier activities, Lake Matheson and West Coast scenery.
Rooms
We have 12 ground-floor Fox Glacier accommodation units located in our spacious grounds. All our motel units are smokefree.
Studio Units Rooms 1-4
1-Bedroom Units Rooms 5 & 6
Large 2-Bedroom Units Rooms 7 & 8

Fox Glacier Accommodation
We have 12 ground-floor units, situated on spacious grounds in a beautiful garden setting. We have 6 studio units, 2 x 1-bedroom units and 4 x 2-bedroom units. We are a traditional New Zealand motel with well-equipped kitchens and ensuite bathrooms. So whether you are traveling by yourself, with a group of friends or with your whole family we should have an accommodation option to suit you.
We provide free fibre broadband and are the only motel in Fox Glacier offering SKY TV, including SKY Movies, SKY Sports and BBC World.
View Rooms
Fox Glacier Activities
The glacier region offers a large range of things to do glacier hikes and helicopter flights, wilderness walks to Lake Matheson and Gault, beachcombing at Gillespies Beach, biking and hiking through the native rainforest, glowworms, and plenty more... We can advise you on how to get the most out of the area, so please don't arrive on the evening and leave first thing in the morning why not stay a couple of nights?
View Activities
Fox Glacier Accommodation FAQs
What accommodation options are available at Rainforest Motel?
Rainforest Motel has 12 ground-floor smokefree motel units in Fox Glacier, including studio units, 1-bedroom units and 2-bedroom units.
Is Rainforest Motel close to Fox Glacier village?
Yes. The motel is at 15 Cook Flat Road, around 100 metres from the main highway and within walking distance of restaurants, the shop and local activity providers.
Do the rooms have kitchen facilities?
Yes. The units have well-equipped kitchens, and all rooms include microwave ovens. Rooms 7 and 8 also have full ovens.
Is parking available?
Yes. Rainforest Motel provides plenty of parking right outside the units.
What attractions are near Rainforest Motel?
Guests can explore Fox Glacier, Lake Matheson, Lake Gault, Gillespies Beach, glacier walks, scenic flights, native rainforest walks and glowworms from the Fox Glacier area.
How can guests book direct?
Guests can use the Book Now and Book Online links on this website, phone +64 3 751 0140 or call 0800 RAINFOREST.

Rainforest Motel Location | Fox Glacier Accommodation
RAINFOREST MOTEL'S LOCATION
Fox Glacier village is the most logical and convenient stopping point on the South Westland Highway. We are just a 2-hour drive south of Hokitika and a 3.5-hour drive north of Wanaka, with each direction having plenty of scenic stopping places and lookouts along the way.
The Rainforest Motel is situated off the main highway, 100 metres down Cook Flat Road. We therefore have a quiet location but with the benefit of being within walking distance of the restaurants, shop and activity providers.
Rainforest Motel is located in Fox Glacier village on the West Coast of the South Island, making it a convenient stop between Hokitika and Wanaka and a practical base for Lake Matheson, Fox Glacier, Gillespies Beach and local activity providers.
